events.headline: Klarna rolls out anti-scam call verification globally
events.summary: Call Status Detection is now available globally, letting customers verify callers claiming to represent Klarna through an in-app banner.

events.headline: Klarna expands Mollie agreement with dispute management and Consumer FX
events.summary: Klarna announced enhanced dispute management and Consumer FX capabilities for European merchants using Mollie's existing integrations.

events.headline: Klarna launches payment options on Fresha
events.summary: Fresha integrated Klarna so beauty and wellness businesses can offer eligible clients payment flexibility for appointments, treatments, memberships and packages.

events.headline: Klarna announces payment availability at Kohl's
events.summary: Klarna announced that U.S. shoppers can use its flexible payment options online and in the Kohl's app.

events.headline: Klarna goes live at CarParts.com
events.summary: CarParts.com added Klarna's payment options at checkout, including immediate payment, interest-free installments and financing.

events.headline: Klarna payment options launch on Adorama.com
events.summary: Adorama launched Klarna for online purchases, offering immediate payment, interest-free installments and financing, with sister-site availability planned.

events.headline: Klarna launches Consumer FX
events.summary: Consumer FX lets shoppers buy from participating Klarna merchants internationally and pay in their own currency without an exchange fee.

events.headline: Klarna integrates payments into FreshBooks invoicing
events.summary: Klarna partnered with FreshBooks to bring its payment options into invoicing and payment flows for U.S. and Canadian small businesses.

events.headline: Klarna expands Fiserv distribution through Clover and Commerce Hub
events.summary: Klarna announced its Clover in-store launch and an agreement to extend payments to Commerce Hub enterprise merchants in North America, the U.K. and selected European markets.

events.headline: Klarna expands Wayfair payment offerings in the U.S. and Canada
events.summary: Klarna introduced always-on interest-free financing for eligible U.S. Wayfair customers and its full payment suite at Wayfair in Canada.
